quote_en: “The bond market is adjusting to a world of higher neutral rates, where fiscal deficits and firmer productivity growth keep long-term borrowing costs elevated.”
source_block_text_en: Sinai forecasts the 10-year yield could rise to nearly 6% next year and remain above 5% through the 2020s. Yields on Treasury securities are heavily influenced by investors' expectations for how the Fed will set interest rates in coming years.

The 71 analysts who submitted projections in the survey from Oct. 2-7 now expect the benchmark 10-year yield to end 2026 at 5.1%, up from 4.4% the last time we asked, in July. Not all respondents answered every question.
Higher yields are expected to persist. Forecasters see a 10-year yield of 4.96% halfway through 2027 and 4.78% at the end of 2027, up from 4.3% and 4.26% in July projections.

quote_en: “In every major technological shift in history, humanity faces the same temptation: mistaking the tools of our own making for God.”
source_block_text_en: The theme of a higher power creating AI in its own image only for it to rebel against its creator is a familiar one to those who study the Bible. The idea that people in AI labs think they have a power akin to God to create a new kind of consciousness is unsettling, if not blasphemous, to some. And, for others, there is a certain hubris seen in tech leaders chasing a technology that on one hand promises to make them incredibly wealthy while suggesting it is only safe within their control.
